pf.staff.who OKs what: Sam, the broker, or Pat, the office manager, OK the brokerage's settings. The listing side OKs each tour time, through the agent's own tool. Sam's answer wins.
pf.staff.stand-ins: Only another licensed agent at the same brokerage, where the buyer agreement allows it, offered by name. The customer picks. Someone who named an agent is never moved to another on silence: Sam calls instead.

pf.rules.buyer agreement: A written buyer agreement before the first tour, where the state's rules or the brokerage require it (a switch from the state form). Where the state's rules say a buyer can't be made to sign one to tour, Rosie never says one is needed.
pf.rules.fair housing: The AI never steers. It never finds, ranks, suggests or describes homes, areas or people by who lives there, or by any trait the fair housing rules protect. It never calls an area 'safe' or its schools 'good'. Questions about schools, crime or 'good areas' get public sources, never its own opinion. Agents and staff follow the same rule.
pf.rules.same grounds for every buyer: A new buyer is accepted or declined on the same grounds for everyone (the time, the area, another agent), never after seeing the photo ID. Each decline's reason is kept.
pf.rules.another agent's client: A buyer who has signed an exclusive buyer agreement with another agent is sent back to that agent. Nothing is booked.
pf.rules.no advice: Rosie gives no opinion on a home, a price, an offer or a contract. Those go to the agent.
pf.rules.first step only: Rosie books time only. Offers, contracts, earnest money, escrow and closing stay in the brokerage's own tools.
pf.rules.notice at booking: Any notice the state's rules require at the first meeting or tour, like who the agent works for, from the state form. It's said at booking and shown on the secure page.
pf.rules.referral fees: Rosfield takes nothing tied to a sale or a closing. Its $2 per booking sits behind a switch for the rules on referral fees, for Rosfield's lawyer to confirm.
pf.rules.records: Booking records 7 years, or as the state form says. The photo ID is deleted after the tour, or when the brokerage's rule says.
pf.rules.status: Draft: finalized once the state forms are filled in.
